diagnostics.message:
This assignment reads os[n].p.v, so the compiler treats it as an update of os[n].p.v (a relative write, as in the deprecated old SC syntax).
Write it as os[n].p.v += 1 to say so. In one region it means the same.
It only matters when another region also writes os[n].p.v in the same tick: this assignment then runs after that write instead of conflicting with it.
